verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's docs explicitly document idempotency support via the Cko-Idempotency-Key header across payments, authorizations, captures, refunds, cancellations, voids, and transfers endpoints, caching results of 2xx responses to safely retry without duplicate charges, with a configurable idempotency window. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of real-world retry behavior beyond vendor docs.
